people.name: Azrikam
people.line: A descendant of David through Jehoiachin.

people.name: Elioenai
people.line: A descendant of David through Jeconiah.

people.line: A descendant of David through Jeconiah.

people.name: Neariah
people.line: Descendant of David, son of Shemaiah.
